hook: RERA told to re-check River Scape registration, review *all projects*
hook_b: RERA told to re-check River Scape registration, review *all projects*
tldr: The RERA Appellate Tribunal asked TG RERA to re-check the registration of League Spaces LLP's River Scape at Bandlaguda Jagir, after concerns that it may have been registered without all documents and the layout fee.

beats.what: Judicial Member P Pradeep Kumar Reddy directed RERA to check original records and issue notices to the promoter.
beats.why: Seven petitioners, led by Venkatasubbamma of Guntur, sought cancellation, alleging the land was under a family division dispute when registered, per Siasat.
beats.care: The wider review will look at document gaps and unpaid layout fees in project registrations across the state, which matters to anyone buying off-plan.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: RERA Secretary must report within eight weeks.

cards.q: A statewide RERA records review: your take?

qs: How can buyers check a project's RERA documents themselves?
How many projects could the statewide review cover? The order does not say.

facts.t: *Seven* petitioners sought cancellation of River Scape's registrations.

viz.verdict: Outcome depends on the records check

learn.t: RERA = Real Estate Regulatory Authority, which registers projects so buyers can check approvals.

watch: The RERA Secretary's report within eight weeks and any notices to other projects.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: River Scape near Hyderabad under scanner: RERA told to re-check

fact: Tribunal orders TG RERA to re-examine River Scape gated community's registration in *8 weeks*.
twist: The judge also ordered a review of *other real estate projects across Telangana* for similar gaps.
